allowed_computation: stdlib and NumPy arithmetic over saved values, hashes, gzip/JSON/NPZ decoding; no Torch/MuJoCo/SB3/gym/runtime imports or policy replay; no new fitted model or hypothetical control rollout

budget.tests_scope: synthetic saved-field fixtures only, not simulation or training

execution_authorized_scope: One saved-only descriptive diagnosis after the unique evaluation worker and its independent v2 readback close; no physical or learning authorization.

input_scope.latch_cap_explanation: 16 baseline + at most256 training + at most40 evaluation; fewer for real cancellations
input_scope.unknown_extra_files_or_episodes: reject; do not discover additional experiments or select cases by outcomes

interpretation_rules: Final evaluation result is not yet known at contract creation; current online nominal timing cannot substitute for final report.
Report learned versus fixed and zero per matched direction/condition. No cancellation or missing case may be dropped from qualification.
Phase changes, raw actions and clipping/fallback correlations are observational decompositions, not causal counterfactuals.
Do not sum overlapping timing spans, call all post-nominal delay unnecessary waiting, or infer speed from 37mm overshoot without the fixed30mm/time metric.
The400-control retention is an observation/qualification interval, not a forced intercycle dwell; separate cycle speed from preparation+retention experiment throughput.
Pre-update value EV belongs to each distinct collected batch/target and is neither a fixed validation curve nor final64-update critic EV.
Actor/value clipping is independent; do not infer shared-gradient suppression. Small latent KL is not proof of convergence or physical speed gain.
If final gates pass, only recommend a separately budgeted minimal GUI join. If any gain gate fails, stop expansion; this diagnosis does not authorize more training.
No selection of another checkpoint, reward retuning, threshold relaxation, new heldout cases or policy simulation is allowed.
